name: AI literacy
description: Using AI chatbots well for study: asking precise questions and checking what they say.

name: Asking and checking
description: Phrasing a question a chatbot can answer well and checking its claims against independent sources.

name: Ask: a precise question
description: Phrasing a precise, answerable question: the idea, the setting (place and time), and asking for sources and reasoning.
intuition: A vague question gets a vague answer; a precise one gets something you can use and check.

name: Verify: check a claim
description: Checking a chatbot's claim against an independent source: open it, note who published it and when, compare, and say whether it matched.
intuition: Fact-checkers leave the page to see what other sources say before trusting it.
